use: Lobby hero artwork. Gameplay uses independent real-time Three.js geometry.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original premium game lobby artwork for a Korean listening cafe minigame called SYNK, no rendered UI. Create a landscape 16:9 isometric miniature coffee shop with a strong toy-like Nintendo-quality sense of physical craft, entirely original objects, no existing game characters. A beautiful tiny Korean neighborhood cafe in a clean white architectural cutaway, an elegant coral-red espresso machine, lapis-blue refrigerator and glossy glass cups, ice cubes, milk bottle and coffee beans, neatly arranged preparation island at center, giant softly rounded windows, small plants and tasteful felt acoustic panels. Physical materials with convincing ceramic, brushed metal, clear glass, and tactile wool felt, subtle thread seams on upholstered seats; directional morning sunlight and excellent contact shadows, charming substantial rounded proportions, sophisticated mature color restraint. White and black with coral and lapis accents, no beige or cream color cast. A high-end close-view 3D diorama with beautiful believable depth and tiny practical objects, fully legible arrangement, generous empty white negative space at the upper left for a separate HTML heading. Camera looks diagonally from above at the work counter and three empty serving spots; no people, no mascots, no lettering, no text, no logos, no counters, no labels, no watermark, no quiz buttons, no flat vector illustration. This is a hero artwork; the playable cafe will have independently moving 3D cups and ingredients.
